literal: In one birth oneself learned learning, to a person seven births also protection it possesses.
translation: The learning one acquires in a single birth will serve as their protection through seven births.
modern: ஒருவன் ஒரு பிறவியில் தான் கற்ற கல்வியானது, அவனுக்கு ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் பாதுகாப்பாக அமையும் தன்மையுடையது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the enduring value of education. The phrase 'ஒருமைக்கண்' refers to a single lifetime, while 'எழுமையும்' signifies a continuous sequence of future lives, contrasting the short time it takes to learn with its long-lasting benefits. The word 'ஏமாப்பு' means protection or security, showing that knowledge acts as a safeguard against ignorance and hardship. Thus, the learning acquired now becomes an inseparable asset that protects a person far beyond their present existence.
